models.name: Person Detector
models.description: Detect people for Follow Me, SAR, and security

models.name: Depth Estimator (MiDaS v2.1 small)
models.description: Monocular relative depth for the cockpit depth and surfaces layers. Runs only while a depth or surfaces layer is on; the drone scales it to metres with its LiDAR and rangefinder

models.name: Landing Pad Detector
models.description: Detect AprilTag and H-markers for precision landing

models.name: Vehicle Detector
models.description: Detect vehicles for security and traffic monitoring

models.name: Crop Health Detector
models.description: Detect crop health, weeds, and bare soil for agriculture

models.name: Defect Detector
models.description: Detect cracks, corrosion, and spalling for inspection

models.name: Thermal Person Detector
models.description: Detect people in thermal imagery for SAR and night ops

models.name: Gesture Recognizer
models.description: Recognize hand gestures for drone control

models.name: Person Detector (YOLOX-Tiny)
models.description: Person-only detector for Follow Me on boards without an NPU. YOLOX-Tiny exported to ONNX with in-graph box decoding; reproducible with scripts/models/export_yolox_person.py in the drone agent repository

models.name: Person Re-ID (OSNet x0.25)
models.description: Appearance embedding for boards without an NPU: keeps a tracked subject's identity across an occlusion. 512-d output, ImageNet-normalized 256x128 input; reproducible with scripts/models/export_osnet_reid.py in the drone agent repository. Benchmark and explicit install only: the weights were trained on a research-use dataset, so the shipped default re-id is the model-free colour histogram
models.license: MIT (code); weights trained on MSMT17, research-use terms
